Paste a key from Google AI Studio to have books read aloud. Requests are billed to that key.
The text being read aloud is sent to Google to make the voice.
Asking Gemini for its speech models…
This key has no speech models listed. Type one instead.

Google\'s online voices, billed to your Gemini API key.
Google\'s Gemini, on your API key. Passages are sent to Google.

Add your Gemini API key on the Services page to translate with Gemini.
Paste a key from Google AI Studio to read aloud or translate with Gemini. Requests are billed to that key.
Text read aloud or translated with Gemini is sent to Google.
Google\'s ML Kit translator, run on the phone once its languages are downloaded. Passages stay on the phone.
Translate the page from here with Google
To translate on this phone, Google\'s translator needs: %1$s. Each language is about 30 MB and downloads over Wi-Fi only.
Connect to Wi-Fi first. Languages download over Wi-Fi only.
The download failed. Check the Wi-Fi connection and try again.
There is not enough free space on this phone for these languages.
Google\'s ML Kit translates on this phone, so book text is not sent to Google. ML Kit does send Google diagnostic and usage data, such as errors and timings.
